The '''Grand Lord's Throne Room''' was where the [[Grand Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] would hold audience with their [[High Lord]]s. [[Korsin Bentado]] had an audience with Grand Lord [[Varner Hilts]], and asked for the orders to carry out the full [[Invasion of Alanciar|invasion]] of [[Alanciar]], using sixty more of the Tribe's [[Airship/Legends|airships]].
